q-103238.name: Question 1
q-103238.worked_solution:
We substitute $x=8$ and then evaluate the absolute values before we simplify the rest of the expression:

$$
\begin{aligned}|x-5|-|3-x|+2 & = \\ |8-5|-|3-8|+2 & = \\ |3|-|-5|+2 & = \\ 3-5+2 & = \\ 0 & \end{aligned}
$$

q-131806.name: Question 2
q-131806.worked_solution:
We substitute $x=2$ and then evaluate the absolute value before we simplify the rest of the expression:

$$
\begin{aligned}|3-{2}^{x}|+4 & = \\ |3-{2}^{2}|+4 & = \\ |3-4|+4 & = \\ |-1|+4 & = \\ 1+4 & = \\ 5\end{aligned}
$$
